basic_profile.bio: GuitarWanderer2023 is a 25-year-old music enthusiast based in Malmo, Sweden. After finishing a degree in music technology at DePaul University, they moved to Sweden for a new job opportunity as a junior sound engineer. Passionate about DIY projects, especially building guitar amplifiers, they spend weekends tinkering in their small home workshop. They are in a long-distance relationship with their partner back in the U.S. Typically online during evenings and weekends, they enjoy engaging with communities that discuss mental health and music. Despite their recent relocation, they are keen on integrating into local culture and exploring new places.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in music technology from DePaul University, they have a solid understanding of audio engineering and sound design. Their skills are further enhanced by hands-on experience with DIY projects, particularly in crafting and modifying guitar amps. They are self-taught in many practical aspects of electronics through online tutorials and community forums, which has broadened their knowledge base beyond formal education.
